scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: A desk of records
scenes.caption: Reva and Nikhil are opening a school repair desk for torn book covers. Their fictional practice folder contains request slips, a volunteer rota and a public progress board. Each record helps someone do a different job.
scenes.speech: Reva and Nikhil are opening a school repair desk for torn book covers. Their fictional practice folder contains request slips, a volunteer rota and a public progress board. Each record helps someone do a different job.
scenes.dialogue: Start with the job each record serves.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: Follow the movement
scenes.caption: Nikhil draws arrows from the request form to the teacher, then from approved ticket numbers to volunteers. Reva adds the public board. It needs totals, while the teacher needs contact details for returning completed books.
scenes.speech: Nikhil draws arrows from the request form to the teacher, then from approved ticket numbers to volunteers. Reva adds the public board. It needs totals, while the teacher needs contact details for returning completed books.
scenes.dialogue: The same folder need not mean the same audience.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: An accidental shortcut
scenes.caption: A volunteer copies the whole request sheet into a public link to save time. Another person forwards it. Nobody needs to break a password: the sharing setting already lets unintended readers see private practice records.
scenes.speech: A volunteer copies the whole request sheet into a public link to save time. Another person forwards it. Nobody needs to break a password: the sharing setting already lets unintended readers see private practice records.
scenes.dialogue: A mistake can open the door.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Match the control
scenes.caption: Reva suggests restricting the original sheet and publishing a separate total. Nikhil suggests renaming the link instead. The teacher asks which action changes who can open the records, rather than merely changing how the link looks.
scenes.speech: Reva suggests restricting the original sheet and publishing a separate total. Nikhil suggests renaming the link instead. The teacher asks which action changes who can open the records, rather than merely changing how the link looks.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: A smaller exposure
scenes.caption: The restricted sheet now refuses the visitor test account, while the public board still shows progress. That is useful evidence about current access. It does not prove that nobody copied the earlier public sheet before the setting changed.
scenes.speech: The restricted sheet now refuses the visitor test account, while the public board still shows progress. That is useful evidence about current access. It does not prove that nobody copied the earlier public sheet before the setting changed.
scenes.dialogue: Record what the test can show.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Draw the risk map
scenes.caption: You will connect supplied records to their readers, test a draft sharing plan and repair it after another forwarded link. Explain the consequence each control addresses. Keep one remaining uncertainty beside the finished risk map.
